description: Appointment hour box accepted any shape WPF could coerce: typing 10.00 or 20-00 silently saved 10:00
repro_steps: Agenda > new appointment > type 10.00 in the Hora box > Save > the appointment lands at 10:00

description: Appointment duration box bound the int directly, so WPF coerced whatever it could instead of refusing it
repro_steps: Agenda > new appointment > type a non-number in the Durada box > Save

description: Sale line VAT box bound raw basis points, so a typed 21 meant 0,21 % and was frozen onto the sale
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type 21 in the VAT box > Charge > the ticket keeps 0,21 %

description: Sale line quantity box bound the int directly and was never validated before charging
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type a non-number in the quantity box > Charge

description: Till movement crashed on Save when Desglossar IVA was ticked and the VAT box held anything but a number
repro_steps: Till > new cash in > tick Desglossar IVA > type letters in the VAT box > Save > FormatException from decimal.Parse

description: Opening-hours boxes guessed at 9, 0900 and 9.00, the same leniency that made 10.00 read as 10:00
repro_steps: Settings > opening hours > type 9.00 as a start hour > Save

description: Service duration accepted anything and silently stored no duration at all when it did not parse
repro_steps: Catalogue > new service > type letters in the duration box > Save > the service is saved with no duration

description: Client mobile and email were never format-checked
repro_steps: Clients > new client > type letters as the mobile > Save

description: Money.TryParse threw OverflowException instead of returning false for an out-of-range amount, crashing every price/amount box that guards with it
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type 99999999999 as the price > Charge > unhandled OverflowException

description: SaleLineViewModel.AmountCents (price * Quantity) was unchecked int arithmetic with no upper bound on Quantity, so a large quantity silently overflowed and froze a wrong total onto the sale
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > price 1000,00 and quantity 3000000 > Charge > the ticket total is wrong/negative

description: Appointment.EndTime and AvailabilityService computed the end of an appointment with TimeOnly.AddMinutes, which wraps past midnight silently, breaking overlap and opening-hours checks for a late appointment with a long duration
repro_steps: Agenda > new appointment > 23:30 start, 90 min duration > Save > no overlap/out-of-hours warning even though it runs past closing

description: Editing a sale (or charging an appointment) stamped DateTime.Now over its date, moving a recorded sale out of its VAT quarter, its month in the reports and onto today's till
repro_steps: Sales > open a sale from a previous month > Edit > Charge > the sale is now dated today

description: Till VAT breakdown, till movements and the sale line total bound raw *Cents properties, so cents were printed as if they were euros: a 121,00 EUR period read 12100,00 and a 15,00 EUR sale line read 1500
repro_steps: Till > any period with sales > the per-rate table and the Amount column show figures 100x too large; Sales > new sale > add a line > the line total shows raw cents

description: The till's VAT block showed the till balance under a Total label: both were bound to BalanceText, so the VAT total included cash movements that carry no VAT
repro_steps: Till > add a cash movement > the Total in the IVA block changes even though no sale did

description: The per-rate VAT table was hidden whenever the period used a single VAT rate, so the rate the money was taxed at was not shown at all
repro_steps: Till > a period whose sales all use 21% > the per-rate table is not rendered

description: Till movements table showed the raw DateOnly and the stored enum name (In/Out) instead of localised text, and the Category and Worker columns were always blank because the query never included them
repro_steps: Till > add a cash out with a category and a worker > the row shows In/Out untranslated and no category or worker

description: Most spend and Highest average rankings listed client names without the amount they were ranked on
repro_steps: Reports > the two ranking cards show only names

description: Sale dialog line headers declared 7 grid columns while each row declared 11, so every header sat left of the box it named and drifted further across the row
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > the Quantitat/Preu/IVA headers do not line up with their boxes

description: Money.TryParse stripped group separators without validating them, so a stuck comma key turned 12,,50 into 12,50 and 1,2,3,4 into 123,40 - a number nobody typed, frozen onto the sale
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add a line > type 1,2,3,4 as the price > Charge > the line is accepted as 123,40 EUR

description: ClientRecordViewModel formatted the average spend with a bare C2, taking the Windows regional setting instead of the app language, so one figure followed a different culture from the rest of the screen
repro_steps: Clients > open a client record with sales > the average is formatted differently from the total

description: ApplicationWpf test fixture waited on a ManualResetEventSlim with no timeout and swallowed any exception from App.InitializeComponent, so a broken App.xaml hung the whole test run instead of failing it
repro_steps: Break a StaticResource in App.xaml > run dotnet test > the run hangs with no output and no failing test

description: DatePicker.SelectedDate (DateTime?) was bound directly to a DateOnly/DateOnly? property with no converter in five pickers (Reports period range, Till custom range, Export range, client birth date), so the binding silently failed both ways: the picker showed empty and nothing typed ever reached the ViewModel
repro_steps: Informes > change the date range above Ranquing de treballadores > the worker ranking and detail never update

description: The 'Desglossar IVA als moviments de caixa' setting is written but never read, and the movement dialog hardcodes 21% instead of the configured default VAT rate
repro_steps: Settings > set the default VAT to 10% and tick 'Desglossar IVA als moviments de caixa' > Till > new cash out > the Desglossar box is still shown and unticked, and the VAT box reads 21

description: SettingsService.InvalidateCache blocks the UI thread on a SemaphoreSlim, so a restore can deadlock against any settings read in flight
repro_steps: Settings > restore a backup while another page is loading settings > the app hangs with no error

description: BackupService, AppointmentService, TillService and ExportService write or destroy data with no log line at all: restore, backup pruning, cash movement create/delete, appointment cancel/delete and the CSV export leave no audit trail
repro_steps: Settings > restore a backup > the log file has nothing between 'Application started' and 'Application closed'

description: Lowering 'Copies a conservar' permanently deletes backups with no confirmation and no log
repro_steps: Settings > change the number of backups to keep from 15 to 1 > Save > 14 backup files are deleted instantly with no warning

description: A File.Delete failure while pruning old backups makes a successful manual backup report as an error, so the user retries a backup that was already taken
repro_steps: Settings > hold an old .db in the backups folder open (antivirus, Explorer preview) > Fer copia ara > the new file is written but an unexpected-error dialog appears

description: Two user-visible strings are hardcoded Catalan literals in XAML StringFormat and are never translated
repro_steps: Settings > Idioma > Espanol > restart > the sales footer reads '12 vendes actives' and the slot-size picker reads '30 minuts' in a Spanish interface

description: ConfirmVatModeChange sets _modeVatSaved before awaiting the save, and is called fire-and-forget, so a failed write leaves the picker showing a VAT mode that was never stored and no error is surfaced
repro_steps: Settings > change the VAT mode with the settings write failing > the picker keeps the new mode and every later sale is still frozen in the old one

description: Eight (int) casts on long aggregates on the way to Money.Format reintroduce the clamps Money.cs documents as removed (HomeViewModel, ReportsViewModel, TillService)
repro_steps: Till/Home/Reports with a period total above 21.474.836,47 EUR > the figure wraps to a negative or wrong amount

description: The sales page footer sums int cents with Enumerable.Sum, which is checked and throws instead of widening
repro_steps: Sales > clear all filters with a lifetime total above 21.474.836,47 EUR > the page fails to load with an unhandled OverflowException

description: VatCalculator.ComputeByRate sums line amounts into an int, so two individually valid lines at the same VAT rate can overflow and crash while typing
repro_steps: Sales > new sale > add two lines at the same VAT rate, each priced 20000000,00 > the dialog throws an OverflowException on a keystroke

description: ExportService declares a fixed ca-ES culture so the CSV does not follow the interface language, but WriteSales formats through Money.FormatExport (interface culture, N2 with group separators) while WriteVat uses the fixed culture with F2 - the two files in one export disagree on number format
repro_steps: Sales > Exportar periode over a quarter containing a 1250,00 EUR sale > vendes_*.csv shows 1.250,00 and iva_*.csv shows 1250,00

description: AppointmentService.Create does not fire NotifyChanged while Update, ChangeStatus and Delete do, so a newly booked overdue appointment does not reach the shell notice until the next timer tick
repro_steps: Agenda > book an appointment for two hours ago > the overdue notice does not appear until the timer ticks

description: GetOverduePending only looks back 24 hours, so an appointment left Pending more than a day ago is invisible in the overdue notice forever
repro_steps: Agenda > leave a Friday appointment Pending > on Sunday the shell notice no longer mentions it
